title: QUIC RFC 9000 Client First-Flight Connection ID Continuity Verification
verification_method: Focused S7P2 requirement-home tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers only the client first-flight connection-ID floor before the client processes any server Initial or Retry packet.
expected_result: The requirement-home tests show the client host generates an independent, non-zero first Initial Destination Connection ID, keeps it at the implementation's 8-byte minimum, does not reuse it across separate connection hosts, preserves it across Initial bootstrap and recovery retransmission before server receipt, and keeps 0-RTT first-flight Destination and Source Connection IDs aligned with the first Initial packet while rejecting 0-RTT formatting without an Initial Destination Connection ID.
procedure: Run the focused S7P2 0004/0005/0006/0008 requirement-home filter.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The client host is constructed before ConnectAsync so first-flight CID state can be inspected without network traffic.
The client runtime has configured Initial packet protection and the bootstrap outbound path.
The 0-RTT proof uses formatter-level packet headers and does not claim early-data acceptance.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim client handling of server Initial or Retry Source Connection IDs, later conflicting Source Connection ID discard behavior, preferred-address migration, server-address-change policy, public API widening, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S7P2 0004/0005/0006/0008 requirement-home filter passed 12/12, the broader S7P2 requirement-home filter passed 19/19 with --no-build, the Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks S7P2 0004 through 0008 trace_clean, SpecTrace core validation passed across 415 JSON artifacts, and git diff --check passed.
